units.rawText: <color=orange>On the outskirts of the Oasis, at coordinates (35.6,139.7).</color>

units.rawText: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.
units.displayText: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.

spans.text: It's 13:20 now... 10 minutes until the time mentioned in that mail.

units.rawText: Our combat teams are hidden and in position. Professor, you can give the word at any time.
units.displayText: Our combat teams are hidden and in position. Professor, you can give the word at any time.

spans.text: Our combat teams are hidden and in position. Professor, you can give the word at any time.

units.rawText: Did you learn anything about these coordinates, Persicaria?
units.displayText: Did you learn anything about these coordinates, Persicaria?

spans.text: Did you learn anything about these coordinates, Persicaria?

units.rawText: According to the Security Department, the Sanctifiers' patrol routes often run near this region, but since it's fairly close to the Oasis, they usually don't come this far out.
units.displayText: According to the Security Department, the Sanctifiers' patrol routes often run near this region, but since it's fairly close to the Oasis, they usually don't come this far out.

spans.text: According to the Security Department, the Sanctifiers' patrol routes often run near this region, but since it's fairly close to the Oasis, they usually don't come this far out.

units.rawText: ...So it seems something irregular drew the Sanctifiers here.
units.displayText: ...So it seems something irregular drew the Sanctifiers here.

spans.text: ...So it seems something irregular drew the Sanctifiers here.

units.rawText: Also, we got a message from Ksenia as she was returning. Apparently, Riko's leading a convoy which might very well pass through this place around the stated time.
units.displayText: Also, we got a message from Ksenia as she was returning. Apparently, Riko's leading a convoy which might very well pass through this place around the stated time.

spans.text: Also, we got a message from Ksenia as she was returning. Apparently, Riko's leading a convoy which might very well pass through this place around the stated time.

units.rawText: So the purpose of that email was to help divert the Sanctifiers' attention from Riko? But the Sanctifiers usually don't attack Currency Traders...
units.displayText: So the purpose of that email was to help divert the Sanctifiers' attention from Riko? But the Sanctifiers usually don't attack Currency Traders...

spans.text: So the purpose of that email was to help divert the Sanctifiers' attention from Riko? But the Sanctifiers usually don't attack Currency Traders...

units.rawText: Should we stop Riko's convoy?
units.displayText: Should we stop Riko's convoy?

spans.text: Should we stop Riko's convoy?

units.rawText: No need for that. Let's wait and see what happens. Persicaria, have our scouts track the movements of any nearby Sanctifier patrols.
units.displayText: No need for that. Let's wait and see what happens. Persicaria, have our scouts track the movements of any nearby Sanctifier patrols.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Professor! The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith is leading a force of Sanctifiers toward us at high speed!
units.displayText: Professor! The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith is leading a force of Sanctifiers toward us at high speed!

spans.text: Professor! The Intermediate Sanctifier Faith is leading a force of Sanctifiers toward us at high speed!

units.rawText: So it's Faith... But why are they doing this?
units.displayText: So it's Faith... But why are they doing this?

spans.text: So it's Faith... But why are they doing this?

units.rawText: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.
units.displayText: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.

spans.text: They seem to be pursuing an Irregular Agent... We can't determine said agent's affiliation at this range.

units.rawText: Give me a live update on their positions and visuals on both sides.
units.displayText: Give me a live update on their positions and visuals on both sides.

spans.text: Give me a live update on their positions and visuals on both sides.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Given their speed, they'll arrive at these coordinates soon.
units.displayText: Given their speed, they'll arrive at these coordinates soon.

spans.text: Given their speed, they'll arrive at these coordinates soon.

units.rawText: It seems this Irregular Agent spotted the convoy and decided to hide among the cargo...
units.displayText: It seems this Irregular Agent spotted the convoy and decided to hide among the cargo...

spans.text: It seems this Irregular Agent spotted the convoy and decided to hide among the cargo...

units.rawText: Professor, the scouts have eyes on the Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: Professor, the scouts have eyes on the Irregular Agent.

spans.text: Professor, the scouts have eyes on the Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Through the terminal, <color=orange>I see a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.</color>
units.displayText: Through the terminal, I see a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.

spans.text: Through the terminal,
I see a black-haired girl with a blue hat who appears to be around 15 or 16 years old.

units.rawText: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.
units.displayText: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.

spans.text: She appears skinny, but she's moving surprisingly fast, and she's observing her surroundings as she runs.

units.rawText: Her appearance and clothing... They don't resemble agents from any known sectors.
units.displayText: Her appearance and clothing... They don't resemble agents from any known sectors.

spans.text: Her appearance and clothing... They don't resemble agents from any known sectors.

units.rawText: Also, the strange thing is that although she's clearly in a panic, she's doing her best to keep quiet and not make a sound... I do not understand why she would do that.
units.displayText: Also, the strange thing is that although she's clearly in a panic, she's doing her best to keep quiet and not make a sound... I do not understand why she would do that.

spans.text: Also, the strange thing is that although she's clearly in a panic, she's doing her best to keep quiet and not make a sound... I do not understand why she would do that.

units.rawText: That's very suspicious, yes. However, at the very least we know the purpose of that email now. We were probably meant to help distract the Sanctifiers to help this girl out.
units.displayText: That's very suspicious, yes. However, at the very least we know the purpose of that email now. We were probably meant to help distract the Sanctifiers to help this girl out.

spans.text: That's very suspicious, yes. However, at the very least we know the purpose of that email now. We were probably meant to help distract the Sanctifiers to help this girl out.

units.rawText: However, the Sanctifiers are relentless, and we shouldn't clash with them given that we've only just established cordial relations with them...
units.displayText: However, the Sanctifiers are relentless, and we shouldn't clash with them given that we've only just established cordial relations with them...

spans.text: However, the Sanctifiers are relentless, and we shouldn't clash with them given that we've only just established cordial relations with them...

units.rawText: Indeed. Since we don't know anything about her, we shouldn't show ourselves in person.
units.displayText: Indeed. Since we don't know anything about her, we shouldn't show ourselves in person.

spans.text: Indeed. Since we don't know anything about her, we shouldn't show ourselves in person.

units.rawText: Persicaria, have everyone disguise themselves. Scramble all Signatures and do not reveal your identities as Exiles. Also, prepare for battle.
units.displayText: Persicaria, have everyone disguise themselves. Scramble all Signatures and do not reveal your identities as Exiles. Also, prepare for battle.

spans.text: Persicaria, have everyone disguise themselves. Scramble all Signatures and do not reveal your identities as Exiles. Also, prepare for battle.

units.rawText: While I'd like to pick up this Irregular Agent... we're low on manpower since we pulled these squads together at the last minute, so we'll have a very hard time dealing with both her and Sanctifiers at once.
units.displayText: While I'd like to pick up this Irregular Agent... we're low on manpower since we pulled these squads together at the last minute, so we'll have a very hard time dealing with both her and Sanctifiers at once.

spans.text: While I'd like to pick up this Irregular Agent... we're low on manpower since we pulled these squads together at the last minute, so we'll have a very hard time dealing with both her and Sanctifiers at once.

units.rawText: And we need to lure away all the Sanctifiers under these conditions... It seems future me has set a real toughie this time round.
units.displayText: And we need to lure away all the Sanctifiers under these conditions... It seems future me has set a real toughie this time round.

spans.text: And we need to lure away all the Sanctifiers under these conditions... It seems future me has set a real toughie this time round.

units.rawText: Professor, the Irregular Agent will arrive at our location in 5 minutes' time.
units.displayText: Professor, the Irregular Agent will arrive at our location in 5 minutes' time.

spans.text: Professor, the Irregular Agent will arrive at our location in 5 minutes' time.

units.rawText: I wonder if I should give thanks that we're dealing with an old friend here...
units.displayText: I wonder if I should give thanks that we're dealing with an old friend here...

spans.text: I wonder if I should give thanks that we're dealing with an old friend here...

units.rawText: All agents, split into two teams. A Team will follow my instructions. B Team will listen to Persicaria and hold position.
units.displayText: All agents, split into two teams. A Team will follow my instructions. B Team will listen to Persicaria and hold position.

spans.text: All agents, split into two teams. A Team will follow my instructions. B Team will listen to Persicaria and hold position.

units.rawText: Persicaria, we'll lure away the main force of the Sanctifiers along with Faith. Given her personality, she'll probably detach a small squad of Lesser Sanctifiers to continue tracking the Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: Persicaria, we'll lure away the main force of the Sanctifiers along with Faith. Given her personality, she'll probably detach a small squad of Lesser Sanctifiers to continue tracking the Irregular Agent.

spans.text: Persicaria, we'll lure away the main force of the Sanctifiers along with Faith. Given her personality, she'll probably detach a small squad of Lesser Sanctifiers to continue tracking the Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Once Faith is gone, attack the Lesser Sanctifiers. Given their default action logic, they'll go after you instead.
units.displayText: Once Faith is gone, attack the Lesser Sanctifiers. Given their default action logic, they'll go after you instead.

spans.text: Once Faith is gone, attack the Lesser Sanctifiers. Given their default action logic, they'll go after you instead.

units.displayText: Once all the Sanctifiers have been diverted, we'll double back and pick up Riko and this agent.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Finally, just in case...
units.displayText: Finally, just in case...

spans.text: Finally, just in case...

units.rawText: I lead my agent team close to the Irregular Agent's coordinates. Now that I'm directly viewing the girl, she seems more petite than her image made her look.
units.displayText: I lead my agent team close to the Irregular Agent's coordinates. Now that I'm directly viewing the girl, she seems more petite than her image made her look.

spans.text: I lead my agent team close to the Irregular Agent's coordinates. Now that I'm directly viewing the girl, she seems more petite than her image made her look.

units.rawText: What we don't expect is how the girl seems surprised upon seeing us and instead runs toward us.
units.displayText: What we don't expect is how the girl seems surprised upon seeing us and instead runs toward us.

spans.text: What we don't expect is how the girl seems surprised upon seeing us and instead runs toward us.

units.rawText: Did Okarin send you to save Mayushii?
units.displayText: Did Okarin send you to save Mayushii?

spans.text: Did Okarin send you to save Mayushii?

units.rawText: ...Huh? Where's Okarin...?
units.displayText: ...Huh? Where's Okarin...?

spans.text: ...Huh? Where's Okarin...?

units.rawText: Okarin? I've never heard that name before... Still, since she's willing to work with us, it'll increase our chances of success going forward.
units.displayText: Okarin? I've never heard that name before... Still, since she's willing to work with us, it'll increase our chances of success going forward.

spans.text: Okarin? I've never heard that name before... Still, since she's willing to work with us, it'll increase our chances of success going forward.

units.rawText: You'll meet him soon. We're here to help. The situation is urgent, so I'll save the rest for later.
